stays.name: Fontecruz Lisboa
stays.blurb: Striking postmodern architecture and interior appointments are on the menu throughout this Marriott's luxury, five-star, 72-room boutique hotel.

stays.name: Hotel Avenida Palace
stays.blurb: It's in the emblematic Restauradores Square in a neoclassical building.

stays.name: Tivoli Avenida Liberdade Lisboa
stays.blurb: The five-star, 285-room flagship of the Portuguese Tivoli hotel chain is most known for its rooftop terrace bar with splendid views.

stays.name: Sofitel Lisbon Liberdade
stays.blurb: Five-star, 163-room hotel. Perhaps not particularly outstanding in standards or appointments among other Sofitels in Europe (meaning though that the standards are very high), the Lisbon Sofitel boast…

stays.name: The One Palácio da Anunciada
stays.address: Rua das Portas de Santo Antão 112-134
stays.blurb: Five-star, 83-room hotel in a 16th-century palace with contemporary guest rooms.

stays.name: Intercontinental Lisbon Hotel
stays.blurb: Five-star, 331-room hotel overlooking Parque Eduardo VII.

stays.name: Hotel Portuense
stays.address: Rua das Portas de Santo Antão 149-157

stays.name: Four Seasons Hotel Ritz Lisbon
stays.blurb: Five-star, 282-room hotel with spa, gym, swimming pool, restaurant, and bar.

activities.title: Custard tart crawl
activities.blurb: Hit three bakeries and rank your favorite pastel de nata.

activities.title: Food market tasting
activities.blurb: Graze through stalls of cheese, seafood and port.

activities.title: Tile museum
activities.blurb: Five centuries of azulejos in a former convent.

activities.title: Tram 28 ride
activities.blurb: Rattle up the hills in a 1930s yellow tram. Board early.

activities.title: Fado night in Alfama
activities.blurb: Live Portuguese folk music over dinner in a tiny tavern.

activities.title: Bairro Alto bar hop
activities.blurb: Narrow streets that fill up with people after 11pm.

activities.title: Sunset at a miradouro
activities.blurb: Grab a drink and watch the city turn orange from a hilltop viewpoint.

activities.title: Day trip to Sintra
activities.blurb: Fairytale palaces and forest trails, 40 minutes by train.

activities.title: Beach afternoon in Cascais
activities.blurb: Seaside town with small sandy coves along the coast line.

activities.title: Belém pastry pilgrimage
activities.blurb: The original pastéis de Belém, warm with cinnamon.

activities.title: Seafood feast at a cervejaria
activities.blurb: Clams, prawns and a steak sandwich to finish.

activities.title: Tile painting workshop
activities.blurb: Paint your own azulejo and take it home.

activities.title: Praça do Comércio
activities.blurb: This magnificent plaza, facing the river, is the beginning of Lisboa's downtown.

activities.title: Ginjinha shot in Rossio
activities.blurb: Sour cherry liqueur from a hole-in-the-wall bar.

activities.title: Rooftop drinks in Bairro Alto
activities.blurb: Cocktails over terracotta rooftops at golden hour.
activities.wiki: File:Miradouro de São Pedro de Alcântara - Lisboa - Portugal (17056931499).jpg

activities.title: LX Factory Sunday
activities.blurb: Old factory full of bookshops, street art and brunch.

activities.title: Arrábida coast day trip
activities.blurb: Turquoise coves under green cliffs, plus Setúbal fried cuttlefish.

activities.title: Surf lesson at Costa da Caparica
activities.blurb: Long sandy beach and beginner waves 30 minutes away.

activities.title: Port wine tasting
activities.blurb: Three ports, a cheese plate and a friendly sommelier.

activities.title: Bifana crawl
activities.blurb: Garlicky pork sandwiches from three old-school counters.

activities.title: Rossio Station
activities.blurb: Built in 1890 as the Estação Central (Central Station), it was the main railway hub until 1957.

activities.title: Igreja do Carmo
activities.blurb: The hilltop church of the former convent of Carmo is a towering memorial of the 1755 earthquake, which made the roof of the church collapse, but the Gothic arches of the nave survived.

activities.title: Pink Street night out
activities.blurb: Bars spill onto a bright pink street until 3am.
activities.wiki: File:Lisbon Pink Street Rua Cor de Rosa or Rua Nova de Carvalho, former red light disctrict (50654507622).jpg

activities.title: Teleférico do Parque das Nações
activities.blurb: An aerial tramway built for Expo '98.

activities.title: Sunset sail on the Tagus
activities.blurb: Two hours on the river past the bridge and Belém Tower.

activities.title: Lisbon Botanical Gardens
activities.blurb: A hidden gem. It was created several hundred years ago, by a King of Portugal at the time of the Discoveries.

activities.title: Monsanto Forest Park
activities.blurb: A municipal protected forest, the largest green patch in the city, covering almost 10 km².

activities.title: Belcanto
activities.blurb: Contemporary Portuguese cuisine with two Michelin stars.

activities.title: Cervejaria da Trindade
activities.blurb: This excellent restaurant-brewery in a former monastery has several kinds of Sagres beer and Guinness.

activities.title: Museu Nacional de Arte Antiga
activities.blurb: Portugal's impressive national art collection, including 14-19th century European painting, artefacts of Portuguese contact with the East and Africa and a collection of ecclesiastical treasures.

activities.title: Museu Colecção Berardo
activities.blurb: The permanent collection of the museum consists of the Berardo Collection, which is made up of modern and contemporary art, with major art movements like abstract expressionism, Abstraction-Création, action painting, bo…

activities.title: Teatro Nacional Dona Maria II
activities.blurb: The most famous live theatre stage in Lisbon.

activities.title: Teatro Maria Vitória
activities.blurb: Presenting teatro de revista, Portuguese-style comedy revues.

activities.title: Feira da Ladra flea market
activities.blurb: Tuesday and Saturday treasure hunt behind São Vicente.

activities.title: Ajuda Botanical Gardens
activities.blurb: The botanical garden of Ajuda is one of the oldest gardens in Europe and is considered the first in Portugal.

activities.title: Restaurante Lisboa À Noite
activities.blurb: A restaurant with a variety of traditional Portuguese dishes very appreciated by the tourists.

activities.title: Chapitô à Mesa
activities.blurb: Great views are the main feature if you reserve terrace seat in advance.

activities.title: Ponte 25 de Abril
activities.blurb: This sister bridge of the San Francisco – Oakland Bay Bridge was designed by the same architect in 1966 to connect Lisbon with the Setubal peninsula across the Tagus (Tejo) River.

activities.title: Museu Nacional dos Coches
activities.blurb: Housed in the former riding school of the palace, don't miss the world's largest collection of horse-drawn coaches and other royal vehicles.

activities.title: Selva Comedy Cafe: Life in Lisboa - A cultural comedy show
activities.blurb: This comedy show is 100% in English and features well known comedians from the local and international scene in Lisbon.

activities.title: Chafariz do Vinho
activities.blurb: Perfect place to linger over a glass of wine at this wine bar that is under the arches of the city's former acquaducts.

activities.title: Café Martinho da Arcada
activities.blurb: Established in 1782, this is the oldest continuously-operating café in Lisbon and throughout its history has been associated with important politicians, writers, and intellectuals.

activities.title: Castelo de São Jorge
activities.blurb: Humans settled on this hill as early as the 8th century BCE, and the first fortifications date from the 1st century BCE.

activities.title: Leitaria Camponeza
activities.blurb: On the location of a historical café (the leitaria), this place focuses on only a short number of dishes (meats, fish and seafood) but makes up for this in quality and portion size.

activities.title: Mercado da Praça da Figueira
activities.blurb: From the pavement looks like a small convenience shop, on walking in you realize the deception when confronted by the large cavernous meandering interior space, replete with everything expected from a well stocked super…

activities.title: Santa Justa Lift lisbon 54e
activities.blurb: Excellent vertical view of the Baixa streets, next to Igreja do Carmo.
activities.address: Largo do Carmo - Rua do Ouro

activities.title: Cemitério dos Prazeres
activities.blurb: This large cemetery is packed with majestic gravestones and mausoleums, separated by wide, pedestrian, tree-lined "streets".

activities.title: Gulbenkian Music
activities.blurb: The Gulbenkian Foundation has its own symphony orchestra and ballet group.

activities.title: Tivoli Hotel Sky Bar
activities.blurb: The superbly located rooftop bar of Tivoli Hotel is a small secret.

activities.title: Café A Brasileira
activities.blurb: One of Lisbon's remaining classic cafés, with a restaurant in the basement; despite renovation, not much has changed since the 1920s.

activities.title: Calouste Gulbenkian Museum
activities.blurb: One of the best museums in Lisbon.

activities.title: Néctar WineBar
activities.blurb: A place dedicated to the promotion of Portugal's wine and gastronomic culture, and featuring a daily lunch menu of Portuguese and Mediterranean cuisine.

activities.title: Restaurante Gambrinus
activities.blurb: A restaurant-bar which is one of the most chic places in the city.
activities.address: Rua das Portas de Santo Antao, 23

activities.title: Fundação Arpad Szenes / Vieira da Silva
activities.blurb: This museum is installed in the restored 18th-century former Royal Silk Factory.

activities.title: Aqueduto das Aguas Livres
activities.blurb: This is a historic aqueduct in the city of Lisbon, Portugal.

activities.title: Manteigaria - Fábrica de Pastéis de Nata
activities.blurb: A bakery serving some of the best pastéis de nata in town, arguably the best in Lisbon.

activities.title: Fado In Chiado
activities.blurb: Fado In Chiado - Daily show (except on Sundays) at 19:00, with a duration of 50 minutes.

activities.title: Jardim de São Pedro de Alcântara
activities.blurb: Excellent panorama from the lovely terrace/garden on top of Elevador da Glória and northern corner of Bairro Alto.

activities.title: Casino Lisboa
activities.blurb: Among the gambling opportunities here are slot machines, poker, roulette, black jack, and baccarat.

activities.title: Restaurante Sacramento do Chiado
activities.blurb: A popular locals' place in palace stables from the 18th-century .

activities.title: Restaurante Terra
activities.blurb: Probably the best vegetarian restaurant in Lisbon and also the nicest in terms of ambience and service.

activities.title: Lisbon Cathedral
activities.blurb: Built in 1147, the cathedral has survived various earthquakes and has undergone restoration, renovation, and modification over the years.

activities.title: Praça Marquês de Pombal
activities.blurb: Essentially a large roundabout with a sizeable statue of a former Portuguese prime minister in the middle.

activities.title: Garrafeira Alfaia
activities.blurb: Nice wine bar with an impressive selection of good wines and appetizers.

activities.title: Bar Trobadores
activities.blurb: Medieval bar in downtown with a cozy atmosphere and a diverse range of traditional Portuguese delicacies.

activities.title: Parque Eduardo VII
activities.blurb: Formal park with expansive views down toward the city and water from Miradouro Parque Eduardo VII.

activities.title: Jardim Zoológico
activities.blurb: A zoo that is fairly pricey, but has a variety of exotic animals featuring sea-lions and dolphins.

activities.title: Come Prima
activities.blurb: Traditional Italian fresh pasta dishes, various starters, risottos, meats and wood-oven pizzas are produced from a wide selection of prime quality fresh ingredients.

activities.title: Zambeze
activities.blurb: A Mozambique restaurant on a "miradouro", viewing spot, offering a great view of the river, the Baixa area, and beyond.

activities.title: Basílica da Estrela
activities.blurb: This Neoclassical and Baroque basilica, dedicated to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, was built in the late 1700s by Queen Maria I in fulfilment of a vow.

plan.budgetNote: Stay came in $13 over target, so I moved money from flights, which came in $508 under.
